The Deal Desk function partners across Chainalysis to help teams structure and execute complex commercial deals across the Americas. Combining commercial judgment with analytical rigor, the team develops solutions that meet customer needs while aligning with Chainalysis’ pricing, product, and contractual guidelines.

You’ll join a growing function working closely with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, Legal, Product, Marketing, and other teams. The team helps navigate deal complexity, bring clarity to commercial decisions, and move opportunities forward. This role offers broad exposure to Chainalysis’ go-to-market operations and the opportunity to help shape how we support and scale commercial deals as the company grows.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Support Sales teams in structuring, pricing, and quoting complex commercial deals, developing a deep understanding of Chainalysis’ licensing, subscription, and pricing models to recommend deal structures that meet customer needs while aligning with company strategy and commercial guidelines.

  • Review deal requests, analyze pricing and discounts, and present recommendations to business approvers, while providing guidance on negotiations, contract objections, alternative deal structures, and non-standard order-form requirements.

  • Serve as a key point of contact for Sales on deal pricing, quoting, and deviations from standard processes, helping Sales leaders prioritize opportunities around month-end, quarter-end, and year-end deadlines.

  • Troubleshoot complex quoting challenges in Salesforce CPQ and maintain a knowledge base of recurring deal issues to improve consistency and support Sales effectiveness.

  • Partner closely with Legal, Product, Finance, Revenue Operations, and other cross-functional teams to resolve complex commercial requirements and support accurate forecasting and order booking.

  • Identify and deliver process improvements, including enhancements to Salesforce workflows and system automation, to streamline deal desk operations and improve the overall sales process.

  • Combine commercial judgment with analytical rigor to develop customer-focused solutions that align with Chainalysis’ pricing strategy, product offerings, and contractual guidelines.

  • Navigate increasingly complex commercial arrangements, providing strategic deal-structuring guidance as the business evolves towards consumption-based pricing models.

  • Partner closely with Sales teams to structure, price, and quote complex deals. Develop deep expertise in Chainalysis’ licensing, subscription, and pricing models to recommend commercially sound deal structures that balance customer needs, business objectives, and internal commercial guidelines.

We are looking for candidates who have/are:

  • 5 years of experience in Deal Desk or a related function, preferably within enterprise SaaS or financial technology.

  • Proven experience structuring and reviewing complex SaaS transactions in a fast-growing, multinational company.

  • Experience with Salesforce CRM and Salesforce CPQ, or similar quoting systems.

  • Strong analytical skills, including pricing, discount, and commercial analysis.

  • A solid understanding of Quote to Order processes within the Lead to Cash lifecycle.

  • Experience partnering cross-functionally with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, Legal, Product, or other business teams.

  • Strong judgment and communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and manage competing priorities.

  • The ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment and respond calmly to high-pressure requests.

  • Strong organizational and workload-management skills, with the ability to prioritize based on risk and business needs.

  • A proactive approach to improving processes and systems.

Language requirements:

  • English: Native or equivalent professional fluency

  • Spanish: Required

  • Portuguese: Preferred

Nice to have experience:

  • Supporting sales to crypto exchanges, fintech companies, or payment providers, particularly under consumption-based pricing models.

  • Working with both SaaS and on-premise commercial models.

  • Developing pricing frameworks, approval processes, or scalable Deal Desk operations.

  • Knowledge of revenue recognition principles, including GAAP and ASC 606.

  • Supporting Sales teams across multiple regions and cultures.

  • Working with a consumption-based CPQ platform.

  • Partnering with IT or Business Systems teams on Salesforce enhancements and automation.

Technologies we use:

  • Salesforce

  • Salesforce CPQ

  • Slack

  • Google Workspace

  • Microsoft Office

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.
descriptions.job-1xgk9bj:
About Figure

Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) is the leading blockchain-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale, and trading of tokenized assets. More than 480 partners use its loan origination system and capital marketplace. Collectively, Figure and its partners have originated over $30 billion of loans to date, among other products. The fastest growing components are Figure Connect, its credit marketplace, and Democratized Prime, Figure’s on-chain lend-borrow marketplace. Figure’s ecosystem also includes DART (Digital Asset Registry Technology) for asset custody and lien perfection, and $YLDS, a yield-bearing stablecoin registered with the SEC as a security under the Securities Act of 1933.

Figure is the market leader in real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. The company has received triple-A ratings from S&P and Moody’s on multiple loan securitizations, the first of its kind for blockchain finance.

We’re proud to be recognized as one of Forbes’ Top 50 Fintech Companies and CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Manager, Capital Markets to join our growing team! As Manager within the Capital Markets team, you’ll own day-to-day execution of our secondary transactions, including whole loan trades, liquidity, and warehouse sales and repurchases, while supporting securitizations and investor initiatives. You’ll help scale the settlement, pipeline, and reporting processes behind Figure’s growing origination volume and product suite. The role calls for a strong working knowledge of internal guidelines and external agreements, and close collaboration with Capital Markets, Finance, mortgage operations, origination, and servicing teams, as well as external counterparties.

What You’ll Do

  • Build short- and long-term RTL and DSCR trade plans with pricing and origination teams, aligning takeout and capacity with projected fundings, liquidity needs, allocations, and counterparty terms
  • Manage warehouse facilities day-to-day, including line activity, sales, and repurchases, and track eligibility criteria, concentration limits, advance rates, loan aging, and margin calls
  • Support the Director on warehouse facility renewals and amendments
  • Analyze execution across buyers by comparing bids and reviewing post-trade P&L, and recommend where loans should be allocated based on price, speed, and terms
  • Monitor the funded and in-process pipeline against takeout commitments, and work with risk and origination teams to find the best takeout for each loan across potential buyers
  • Lead trade strategy and loan allocations, optimizing warehouse facility usage and trade channels for best execution
  • Lead the team executing transactions, from investor onboarding and loan pool diligence through resolution of collateral and credit exceptions, settlement, and transaction confirms, and review the team’s work for accuracy and timeliness
  • Serve as the escalation point for diligence findings and exceptions with investors, due diligence vendors, and internal credit teams
  • Build a strong working knowledge of sale and financing contracts, including MLPAs and warehouse agreements, to guide the team’s execution
  • Produce accurate loan tapes for investors, warehouse lenders, and trustees, making sure loan-level data is complete and reconciled before delivery
  • Deliver accurate portfolio and pipeline reporting to support ongoing liquidity, capacity, and capital planning
  • Own monthly reporting requirements under warehouse, trade, and securitization agreements, including counterparty and trustee reporting
  • Reconcile data across internal systems, servicers, and counterparties, and resolve discrepancies at the source
  • Partner with Technology and Product to improve capital markets data and reporting tools and automate manual processes

What We Look For

  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in finance, accounting, economics, or real estate
  • 4+ years of relevant experience in capital markets, structured finance, corporate finance, or mortgage banking
  • Experience with whole loan trades, warehouse lines, or securitizations (strongly preferred)
  • Mortgage or real estate industry experience (preferred, not required)
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with excellent written and verbal communication
  • Proven ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team; experience mentoring or leading junior team members is a plus
  • A get-things-done mentality: a self-starter who identifies, overcomes, and works around obstacles to get to the finish line
  • Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; SQL and Tableau experience (preferred)
  • Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures.
  • Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes.
  • Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team.

Salary

  • Base Compensation Range: $128,000 - $192,000/yr
  • 25% annual bonus target, paid quarterly
  • Company equity in the form of RSUs

This is the compensation range for the role in the United States. Actual compensation may vary based on a candidate’s experience, skills, location, internal equity, and evolving business needs. While most offers are generally made within the middle of the range, final compensation is determined based on the factors above.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employees and their dependents on select plans
  • Company HSA, FSA, Dependent Care FSA, 401(k), and commuter benefits
  • Employer-paid life and disability insurance
  • 11 observed holidays and PTO plan
  • Up to 12 weeks of paid family leave
  • Continuing education reimbursement

California Residents, please review our California Employee and General Workforce Privacy Notice for further information. By submitting your application, you are agreeing and acknowledging that you have read and understand the above notice.

descriptions.job-1xzpei7:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

To avoid the worst effects of climate change, most climate models agree the world will need to dramatically reduce emissions and remove 5-10 billion tons of carbon dioxide from the atmosphere per year by 2050. The Climate team’s goal is to accelerate Stripe’s path to net zero in parallel with the world’s. We do this by reducing Stripe’s emissions and leading initiatives to increase the likelihood we build sufficient carbon removal capacity to reach global climate goals.

In 2019, we developed the first measurement of Stripe’s emissions. In 2021 we launched Stripe Climate, enabling merchants to direct a fraction of their revenue to help scale emerging carbon removal technologies. In 2022 we launched Frontier, an advance market commitment to buy $1.8B+ of permanent carbon removal by 2040. In 2024, we entered our first multi-year offtake for clean energy.

Today, Stripe’s corporate net zero program is entering a new phase. We are looking to streamline our emissions measurement, create a template for catalytic emission reductions, and champion buying removals on the path to net zero, all while meeting our expanding global ESG disclosure requirements.

What you’ll do

As Stripe’s Climate Program Manager, you will set the strategy and lead the execution and reporting for Stripe’s corporate net zero program. You’ll partner with a wide range of stakeholders within and outside of Stripe – Accounting, Finance, Legal, Procurement, Facilities, Sales, and carbon accounting and assurance providers – to refine our greenhouse gas inventory, deliver a reduction and removal roadmap that meets our climate targets, and provide inputs to global ESG disclosures.

This role requires someone with expertise in carbon accounting and reductions strategy, sharp program and process management, a track record of getting big things done fast, and excellent judgement to make the ‘right’ recommendations for Stripe’s program.

Responsibilities

  • Net Zero strategy (~15%): Own and evolve Stripe’s corporate net zero strategy, including Stripe’s transition plan, priorities, budget, annual goals, emissions forecasts, removal retirements, and progress tracking. Stay current on evolving disclosure requirements, net zero guidance, and industry best practices to ensure Stripe’s program is high impact and best in class 
  • Emissions measurement (~30%): Build Stripe’s annual greenhouse gas inventory. Collect data inputs, evolve methodology, manage Stripe’s footprint vendors, run a rigorous and auditable process with cross-functional stakeholders, and identify opportunities to use AI to improve the process
  • Emissions reporting (~30%): Serve as Stripe’s subject-matter expert to deliver inputs to ESG controllership for regulatory disclosures and to customers for RFPs
  • Reduction program (~25%): Develop and manage emissions reduction initiatives across Stripe. This will include efforts like securing renewable electricity for Stripe’s scope 2 emissions, as well as supporting the creative and high-impact interventions like carbon removal or lower-emission data centers that we need to reach global net zero

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • BA or BS degree
  • 5-7+ years of experience in corporate sustainability, climate strategy, carbon accounting, environmental consulting, or a related field
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills – especially adept at translating complexity into clear recommendations 
  • A track record of generating and implementing ambitious emissions reduction initiatives
  • Strong quantitative skills and expertise in emissions accounting and Greenhouse Gas Protocol

Preferred qualifications

  • Has led a corporate climate program in a sector with a significant Scope 3 footprint, ideally technology or financial services
  • Is a self-starter, and has a proven track record of producing measurable reductions through clean energy, cloud usage, and other supplier engagement initiatives 
  • Has a working knowledge of major emissions accounting and climate reporting standards and requirements (e.g., CSRD, California SB 253, GHG protocol), and experience with Watershed or similar enterprise carbon management  platforms
  • Has experience partnering with cross functional controllership partners to manage a greenhouse gas inventory process that meets requirements for limited or reasonable assurance 
  • Is an exceptionally fast learner. Enjoys (and has experience) quickly ramping on new reduction technologies and sustainability standards
descriptions.job-0hmfx4f:
Own Your Intelligence

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team.

Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high-performance training, and deployment into one full-stack system for post-training at frontier scale - from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are building open frontier AI: open-source models trained end to end for long-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own.

Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators, including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go-to-market for a category that does not fully exist yet.

Role Impact

We're looking for a Head of Product to bring clear direction and consistent execution to our product team. You'll help turn the infrastructure behind frontier AI into a product that developers and researchers can use to build, evaluate, and improve their own models. You'll lead the team's product work, stay close to design and implementation, and work with our founders and technical leads to choose what matters most. You'll work with Research, Applied Research, and production customers to make this a repeatable loop for continual learning.

Responsibilities

  • Set a focused product direction with the founders and technical leads. Turn customer needs and new technical capabilities into clear choices about what we build next.

  • Shape the connected customer experience across our whole platform: environments, evaluations, training, deployment, and traces. Partner with the teams building Model Factory, Data Factory, inference, and sandboxes to make those workflows work together.

  • Turn the workflows used by Research and Applied Research into product features, testing them with production customers.

  • Connect Data Factory with Model Factory's training and inference workflows. Use production traces to guide the next round of model improvement.

  • Lead product and design from early concepts through launch. Be obsessed with our users’ experience.

Requirements

  • You've built and grown a technical product that (a lot of) people use in production.

  • You’ve led teams while balancing remaining hands-on, and understand when to direct execution vs. getting involved yourself.

  • You have the technical depth to prototype, work with APIs, and reason through system tradeoffs with engineers. Experience in developer tools, AI infrastructure, or ML platforms is required.

  • You care about how a product feels in use and strive to make each experience more simple or useful.

  • Design engineering experience is a big plus: you combine bold product vision with exceptional taste and a track record of shipping polished experiences.

  • You learn directly from customers, write clearly, and can turn an ambiguous problem into a concrete next step.

  • You're obsessed with building open superintelligence and putting the tools and know-how to create it in the hands of ambitious people everywhere.

Particularly useful domain experience: Ownership of agent observability, data curation, training, inference, multi-agent, RL, continual learning, and/or evaluations systems.

Benefits and Perks

  • $200,000–$300,000 base salary plus meaningful equity

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support

  • Full medical, dental, and vision (covered for employees and dependents).

  • Flexible PTO.

  • $200/month health & wellness benefit.

Show us a product you're proud of, what you personally built or led, and how it changed after real people started using it.
descriptions.job-04h1z8v:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The role

We’re looking for an Engagement Marketing Lead to help Square sellers discover more value in our products and build lasting relationships with Square. You’ll lead a team that turns seller insights into strategies that drive product adoption, deepen engagement, and deliver measurable business growth.

You’ll bring together audience strategy, messaging, experimentation, and channel planning to create relevant, connected experiences across the seller journey. Working closely with Product and cross-functional partners, you’ll set priorities, develop your team, and balance long-term growth opportunities with business commitments. The role has global scope, with an initial focus on the U.S.

You will

  • Lead and develop the engagement marketing team. Set outcome-based goals, coach senior strategists, and define quarterly priorities, owners, and dependencies while delivering business commitments.
  • Own cross-product growth priorities. Size opportunities and allocate capacity based on seller needs and business impact. Partner with Product on adoption, monetization, and the end-to-end seller experience.
  • Establish proactive go-to-market planning. Align Product, Growth, Brand, Sales, Customer Insights, Creative, and channel partners on launch support, audiences, messaging, ownership, and resource tradeoffs.
  • Lead program-wide experimentation. Partner with Data Science on coordinated holdouts and incremental measurement. Test recommendations, messaging, incentives, and channels; use evidence and economics to decide what to scale, refine, or stop.
  • Establish communications governance. Set ownership, eligibility, frequency, sequencing, suppression, and risk-based review standards. Resolve competing messages, prevent over-messaging, and protect required communications.
  • Scale execution responsibly. Partner with Lifecycle Operations, GTM Automation, and external agencies on production and automation. Retain accountability for strategy, approvals, access, quality, and escalation.
  • Oversee portfolio delivery and partnerships. Hold owners accountable for launches, ongoing growth, incentives, and partnership commitments. 

You have

  • 10+ years in engagement marketing or equivalent experience demonstrating senior-level impact. A track record of leading teams and delivering measurable portfolio growth.
  • Experience developing senior strategists and partnering with Product leaders. You can align teams, resolve tradeoffs, and establish clear accountability.
  • Strong analytical judgment and hands-on fluency with SQL and analytics tools. You can diagnose seller behavior, size opportunities, assess economics, and distinguish incremental impact from attributed results.
  • Deep experimentation experience and the ability to turn imperfect evidence into clear investment decisions.
  • Strong positioning and messaging skills, with experience connecting audience insight, product value, and channel strategy.
  • Experience building cross-program communications governance and translating strategy into actionable briefs, journey designs, and test plans with Lifecycle Operations.
  • Fluency with lifecycle platforms, personalization, and delivery controls, with experience partnering with Engineering and Data Science on shared capabilities.
  • Clear executive communication, sound judgment in ambiguity, and practical experience using AI to improve the quality or speed of your work.
  • Experience with small-business customers, multi-product platforms, regulated products, agency partnerships, or international growth is valuable.

Bitdeer is a world-leading technology company for AI and Bitcoin mining infrastructure.

Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers and building AI computational infrastructure to support the AI revolution. Bitdeer handles complex processes involved in computing such as equipment procurement, transport logistics, data center design and construction, equipment management, and daily operations. Bitdeer also offers advanced cloud capabilities to customers with high demand for artificial intelligence.

Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer has deployed data centers across multiple countries, including the United States, Norway, Bhutan, and Ethiopia.

To learn more, visit https://ir.bitdeer.com/

About the Role

Bitdeer is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to support financing and fundraising for GPU computing and data-center infrastructure. Based in San Jose, this role will work closely with the regional senior financing leader and cross-functional teams to develop models, evaluate funding alternatives, prepare transaction materials, and support execution. Direct GPU or Data Center experience is helpful but not required; the successful candidate will bring strong analytical skills and relevant experience from banking, credit, equipment finance, corporate finance, treasury, or another transaction-oriented environment.

What You Will Be Responsible For

  • Financial Modeling: Build and maintain detailed financing, cash-flow, debt-service, and return models for GPU purchases and data-center projects.
  • Capital & Structure Analysis: Analyze financing alternatives, including equipment loans, leases, asset-backed facilities, project financing, private credit, vendor financing, and other structured solutions.
  • Transaction Materials: Prepare lender presentations, information packages, financial schedules, diligence responses, approval materials, and executive summaries.
  • Execution Support: Support financing processes from market research and lender outreach through term-sheet evaluation, diligence, documentation, closing, funding, and post-close monitoring.
  • Covenant & Milestone Tracking: Track project capital expenditures, funding availability, utilization, interest, fees, covenant requirements, payment schedules, and key financing milestones.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Finance, Treasury, Legal, Tax, Accounting, Operations, and Procurement to validate assumptions and maintain consistent source data.
  • Scenario Modeling: Develop scenario analyses connecting GPU deployment, utilization, power and facility capacity, revenue, operating costs, capital expenditures, and liquidity.
  • Process & Controls Improvement: Improve templates, reporting, controls, and data processes that support a scalable global financing function.
  • Market Intelligence: Conduct market and comparable-transaction research on data-center, digital-infrastructure, equipment-finance, and AI-compute financing trends.
  • External Partnerships: Support communications and execution activities with U.S. banks, equipment lessors, private-credit providers, infrastructure investors, and strategic partners.

How You Will Stand Out

  • Education: Bachelor degree in finance, accounting, economics, business, engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience: Typically 3 to 6 years of relevant experience in investment or commercial banking, corporate finance, project finance, equipment finance or leasing, credit, treasury, transaction advisory, or FP&A.
  • Technical Skills: Advanced financial modeling and analytical skills, with strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Data Management: Ability to organize large volumes of financial and operational information and communicate conclusions clearly.
  • Execution & Detail: Strong attention to detail, ownership, follow-through, and ability to manage multiple deadlines.
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work across functions, seniority levels, and geographies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in data centers, GPUs, servers, technology hardware, energy, infrastructure, equipment leasing, or another capital-intensive sector.
  • Experience supporting debt, lease, project-finance, private-credit, or asset-backed transactions.
  • Familiarity with financial statements, credit agreements, covenant calculations, and financing-related accounting concepts.
  • Mandarin proficiency is a plus but not required. The role will operate in English while collaborating with some colleagues and stakeholders in Asia.

Success will be measured by the quality and speed of financing execution, accuracy and transparency of financial analysis, strength of internal and external partnerships, and the ability to help Bitdeer fund GPU and data-center growth while maintaining disciplined economics and risk controls.

Lightspark is creating the Money Grid, modern, open financial infrastructure that makes payments accessible, affordable, and instant for businesses and users worldwide. We are looking for a Risk Manager to lead the risk management function of Lightspark’s Estonian regulated entity, an e-money institution and crypto-asset service provider. The role will be responsible for building out and running a risk framework that keeps pace with a fast-growing business, covering everything from risk appetite and key risk indicators to ICT risk, business continuity and the safeguarding of client funds. You will work closely with the Management Board, the Supervisory Board and teams across the business, giving practical risk guidance that supports sustainable growth with a risk based methodology applied to new business. If you enjoy building structure from the ground up, want real ownership of a second-line function and are interested in stable coins, card payments and embedded finance, this is a good opportunity to make a real difference.

As the Risk Manager, you will report to a member of the Management Board and own the company’s risk management framework end to end. Your work will cover the risk appetite statement and its reporting, risk and control registers, key risk indicators, company-wide risk assessments, fraud risk, ICT and security risk under DORA, business continuity, third-party risk and oversight of finance-related risks such as own funds and safeguarding. You will also lead our risk-related supervisory reporting, prepare the company for supervisory reviews and build risk awareness across the organization. This is a second-line role where independent judgement and the ability to turn regulation into working processes matter equally.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and develop the risk management policies and procedures, including their annual review and the risk-related processes embedded in other company policies.

  • Map the company’s key risks to first-line owners, define measurable and collectible key risk indicators and set up ongoing risk monitoring.

  • Build and maintain the risk and control register, with a documented annual review cycle.

  • Finalize and run the Risk Appetite Statement, including mapping data sources, populating the reporting form and reporting quarterly to the Management Board and the Supervisory Board for approval.

  • Lead company-wide risk assessments, including for new products, business lines and material changes.

  • Develop card payment fraud risk processes together with Operations, building on the existing fraud risk policy.

  • Lead ICT and security risk management in line with DORA, including the ICT risk register, ICT and information asset registers and the vendor register, and deliver the ICT risk work plan.

  • Own business continuity management, keeping the business impact analysis and business continuity plan current as new business lines, processes and vendors are added, and run incident management walkthroughs and tabletop exercises with the group information security team.

  • Manage ICT third-party risk, including reviewing vendor agreements against DORA requirements and preparing the register of information for supervisory reporting.

  • Lead risk-related supervisory reporting, including operational risk and DORA reporting, and prepare the company for supervisory inspections, including on ICT risk management and crypto-asset custody.

  • Oversee finance-related risks, including periodic own funds calculations and projections, secure and highly automated safeguarding account flows without single-person access, and reporting obligations to stablecoin issuer partners.

  • Prepare clear risk management reports for the Management Board and the Supervisory Board.

  • Build a culture of risk awareness, including running the annual risk training and internal workshops.

  • Work with Compliance, AML, Legal, Operations, Product, Engineering and Finance to build risk management into daily operations.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • 3+ years of experience in risk management at a credit institution, e-money institution, payment institution, investment firm or crypto-asset service provider, or equivalent experience in the financial sector or at a public authority.

  • Ideally, experience in working closely with and/or co-ordinating communication with the Estonian FSA

  • University degree in finance, economics, business, law or a comparable field preferred.

  • Solid knowledge of EU and Estonian risk management regulation and guidelines, including DORA, the relevant EBA guidelines on internal governance, ICT and security risk and outsourcing, and the own funds and safeguarding requirements under EMD and PSD2.

  • Hands-on experience building risk frameworks, such as risk appetite statements, key risk indicators, risk and control registers, business impact analyses and business continuity plans.

  • A good understanding of ICT risk, information security and third-party risk management.

  • Strong project management skills and a structured way of working, with the ability to run several workstreams against regulatory deadlines.

  • A proactive attitude and the independence to operate as a second-line function, proposing initiatives and developing new ideas on your own.

  • Good communication skills, with the ability to present risk matters to the Management Board and Supervisory Board and explain them in practical terms to non-risk audiences.

  • Knowledge of virtual assets and blockchain technology, crypto-asset custody, card payments and fraud, AML/CFT and sanctions, data protection, or embedded finance and banking-as-a-service setups is a plus.

Working at Bitso

We are a diverse team that takes pride in understanding the perspectives of others. We fully embrace working remotely and we are eager to act, improve and drive rapid progress inside and outside of our organization.

Your Purpose

As an Onboarding Operations Analyst, you will be responsible for supporting the customers registration and onboarding process within Bitso Business. You will actively manage the workflow for account registration, ensuring efficiency and compliance while contributing to strategic improvements that enhance scalability. Your insights will play a key role in enabling Bitso Business accounts to become fully operational. Collaborating cross-functionally, you will optimize workflows, streamline processes, and ensure the seamless execution of daily operations. Your role will be essential in identifying bottlenecks, improving system performance, and driving continuous enhancements across our platform.

Also, you are going to be responsible to give support to customers with issues related with access to their accounts, 2FA reset, data updates and so on.

Location

Mexico City

Reports To

Business Operations Manager

What You Will Do

  • Review and process customer applications for Bitso Business accounts, ensuring all required documents are submitted and validated.
  • Identify inefficiencies in the onboarding process and suggest improvements.

  • Coordinate with KYB, Compliance, Legal, Fraud, and Tech teams to resolve onboarding issues.

  • Assist customers with onboarding-related questions and troubleshoot registration issues.

  • Give support after the account onboarding, with issues related to the accounts access, the activation of new products, data updates…

  • Strong analytical skills and experience with ticket service tools (e.g., Jira, Zendesk).
  • Ability to identify inefficiencies and propose effective solutions to improve processes.

  • Capability and great communications skills to manage support meetings with customers when necessary.
